description.value:
Potion, uncommon

Component: Phial of Plant (festersap) sap

"More stimulating than a Branton Quark Wand of Lightning Bolts earthing itself through you, and twice as tasty! Grab yourself a venti, double-foam, triple-honeycomb, iced frappedew at your local Starstags today!" — Sunstags Sales Rep

A drop in a morning cup of guava juice gives any Humanoid worth their adenosine receptors a zip to their day. A whole phial of the stuff has especially invigorating effects. As a bonus action, you can drink this phial of Honeydew to gain the effects of the sugar rush spell for the next minute.

After the effects expire, you must make a Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 plus 4 for each additional Honeydew you have consumed in the past week.
